svg.title: Swir // Pixel Tank Patrol LIVE
svg.desc: Original pixel tank automatically aims and fires at every active GitHub calendar day, once per loop. Hit cells vanish, the score credits their actual contributions, and the grid returns. 2025-09-19 to 2026-09-18; 6628 contributions in 25 active days. Continuous 29.5 second animation; snapshot 2026-09-18 03:49 UTC. This is a visualization, not a playable game. Reduced-motion preferences display the intact grid without animation.
